summary.headline: Hyleg and Alcochoden
summary.text: Instructions for selecting the Hyleg from the ascendant, Part of Fortune, or the degree of the preceding conjunction or opposition, and for determining when an Alcochoden is absent. Chapter III then introduces the Alcochoden and begins explaining its significance for life through the lords of the Hyleg’s term, house, exaltation, triplicity, and face.
